about: Lines of code (js, mjs, ts, css, html, py) per area, with ~3% slack: tools/budgets.ts. An area over its budget fails lint; raise a budget only with a new reason describing its current contents and size.

..reason: The root holds the server entry point and the Vite, Vitest and Playwright configurations.

fleet-box.reason: The boxed checker validates generated looks against the library, rig, module chains and light settings.

pi.reason: The Pi adds shared prepared-look rendering and interruptible crossfades in LED light, with a separate held relay frame and regressions for relay gaps, startup levels, duration and gamma output, alongside bake streaming, output lifecycle, guard timing and control-page coverage.

public.reason: The app and sandbox HTML shells load their browser entry points.

public/css.reason: Styles cover the app shell, Studio panels, timeline, live controls, admin pages (the Pi bundle's too) and phone layouts.

public/js.reason: Browser sources combine conditional parameter visibility with editor and Pages fixes for code policy, import previews, admin drafts, invite entry, guest tutorials and reporting notices alongside the core and viewers.

public/patterns.reason: The built-in library provides short standalone examples, with conditional controls and concise headers sharing their detail with help and guides.

render-box.reason: The render box shares deterministic IDs and streaming FSEQ output with the Fleet checker, keeping bake memory independent of duration.

shared.reason: Shared schemas and pure rules define looks, generated compositions, API data, permissions and playback.

src.reason: The server includes shared FSEQ header validation for bounded-memory Pi playback, request-matched queue acceptance and ordered verification timestamps, alongside authentication, storage, generation, baking, frame delivery, live sockets and administration.

test.reason: Suites combine conditional parameter visibility, retained values, zero-glow rendering and settings captures with editor and Pages regressions for pickers, audition, phone controls, menus, reporting, exports and deletion.

tools.reason: Tools build and check rig and palette data, check the Pi bundle holds nothing secret, enforce budgets, support development and backups, and benchmark rendering.
